chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Barqi, from his father, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu Hamzah, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام.
These are two disputants who dispute concerning their Lord.
Then those who disbelieved in the wilayah of Ali, for them garments of Fire shall be cut out.

key_terms.بِوِلَايَةِ: in the wilayah, meaning divinely appointed authority and allegiance

ai.seo_question: How is Qur'an 22:19 interpreted in relation to the wilayah of Ali عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a tafsir of the verse by applying it to belief in the wilayah of Ali عليه السلام. It identifies rejection of his wilayah with disbelief and connects it to punishment in the Fire, highlighting the theological significance of wilayah in Shia tradition.
